verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an IT and identity management product, since comparable tools can ship on-prem or self-managed deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment of Rippling IT. The pack covers only the cloud-delivered product, its REST API (rest.ripplingapis.com), an SDK, and an MCP server, none of which amounts to self-hosting the core product.
